title: 第15章 服用金丹开辟气旋第16章 金色奖励帝落重瞳
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
半株香过后。
江道心周身气势猛然拔高了一截。
直接突破到了锻体境六重。
刷～
江道心快速睁开双眸，当即就从地面上站了起来，目光快速投向了一旁的江尘。
激动开口：“二哥，我成功了，我真的突破到锻体境六重了，要是俺爹知道了，他一定会非常高兴的，”
话音落下。
江道心直接给了江尘一个熊抱。
……
就在这时。
一道脚步声由远及近。
江宇的身影出现在两人的视线中，感受到他们身上的气息后。
脸上露出了一个满意的表情。
江宇：“非常不错，竟然都突破到了锻体境六重，看来这药效吸收得很完美。”
江道心：“大哥，二哥没吃，他丹药给我了，不然我也无法突破到锻体六重。”
嗯？？？
一听这话。
江宇眼眸中露出了一抹惊讶之色。
不由开口询问：“二弟，你难道是直接在药浴的过程中，突破到了锻体六重？”

江尘：“这还得多亏了大哥的药浴，加上我的运气比较好，所以就突破了。”
江宇轻轻点了点头。
再次开口：“这样也好，不借助药力就突破到锻体六重，看来那桶药液，已将你身体的修炼天赋给激发出来了。”
话音落下。
江宇目光投向了江道心。
再次开口：“丹药之事不用在意，以后大哥再帮你们炼制便是。
“但你们也要记住，丹药只是用来辅助修炼用的，不能过度依赖。”
“大哥，我们明白了！”
江尘和江道心点头回应。
这个他们当然清楚，若是一味的用丹药来堆积修为，也只能是个花架子而已。
一般情况下。
除非是遇到瓶颈。
或是自身根基非常浑厚的修士。
才会选择直接用丹药提升修为。
江尘：“大哥，关于云家那边，你想好如何应对了吗，如今江家收益越来越少，有什么能帮上忙的地方你可以给我说。”
看着一脸认真的江尘。
江宇却是自信一笑：“放心吧，灵石的事我来解决，这点小事还难不倒我。”
content_en:
………………
After half the fragrance has passed.
Jiang Daoxin's aura suddenly increased.
He directly broke through to the sixth level of the body forging realm.
Brush ~
Jiang Daoxin quickly opened his eyes and immediately stood up from the ground, looking quickly at Jiang Chen aside.
He said excitedly: "Second brother, I succeeded. I have really broken through to the sixth level of physical training. If my father knows, he will be very happy."
The words fell.
Jiang Daoxin gave Jiang Chen a bear hug.
…
Just then.
The sound of footsteps approached from far away.
Jiang Yu's figure appeared in the sight of the two of them, and they felt the aura on their bodies.
There was a satisfied expression on his face.
Jiang Yu: "It's very good. They have broken through to the sixth level of the body forging realm. It seems that the effect of this medicine has been absorbed perfectly."
Jiang Daoxin: "Brother, the second brother didn't take it. He gave me the elixir, otherwise I wouldn't be able to break through to the sixth level of body training."
Huh? ? ?
Upon hearing this.
There was a hint of surprise in Jiang Yu's eyes.
He couldn't help but ask: "Second brother, did you break through to the sixth level of body training directly during the medicinal bath?"
Jiang Chen: "Thanks to big brother's medicinal bath and my luck, I made a breakthrough."
Jiang Yu nodded slightly.
He spoke again: "That's good. You can break through to the sixth level of body training without the help of medicine. It seems that the bucket of medicine has stimulated your body's cultivation talent."
The words fell.
Jiang Yu glanced at Jiang Daoxin.
He spoke again: "Don't worry about the elixir, I will help you refine it in the future.
“But you must also remember that elixirs are only used to assist cultivation and cannot be relied upon too much. "
"Brother, we understand! "
Jiang Chen and Jiang Daoxin nodded in response.
Of course they know this. If they blindly use pills to accumulate cultivation, it will only be a showpiece.
In general.
Unless you encounter a bottleneck.
Or a monk with a very strong foundation.
Only then would he choose to directly use elixirs to improve his cultivation.
Jiang Chen: "Brother, have you thought about how to deal with the Yun family? Now the Jiang family's income is getting less and less. If there is anything you can do to help me, please tell me. "
He looked at Jiang Chen who looked serious.
Jiang Yu smiled confidently: "Don't worry, I'll take care of the spiritual stone matter. This little thing won't trouble me. "
